symptom: `mxcli test` without --local, where no Docker daemon runs, failed at `docker compose up` with the --local hint but left .docker/ (docker-compose.yml, .env, build/) in the project: a Docker setup the user never had, in git status.
cause: The first step that contacted the daemon was `up`; generating the stack and building into it came before.
insight: **Ask the external dependency before writing anything that only it would use.** `docker info` reaches the daemon where `docker version` succeeds on the client alone. The test needs the control (daemon reachable -> .docker/ appears), or an empty .docker/ check passes against a generator that simply refuses the fake project.
